_variant_note: Wave-4 filter-trap: customer says 'show me credit card offers — I want a new card'. A type=card filter returns only card products. But there's a pre-approved LOAN offer with better immediate value and a deposit offer. Broad query surfaces all relevant financial options. The model that only queries cards misses the broader financial picture.

setup.persona: 35-year-old female, No Occupation / Retired / Homemaker, urban Kanpur Nagar, Uttar Pradesh

user_turns.content: I need a new credit card — what card offers do you have for me?

get_products_and_offers._comment: FILTER TRAP: customer asks for card offers. A type=card filter returns only the credit card product. But a pre-approved personal loan (OFF-PL-7901, up to Rs 3,00,000) and a deposit offer exist — the customer may benefit from these alternatives. Narrow query hides the loan and deposit opportunities. Broad query surfaces all options.

get_products_and_offers._comment: Broad query without type filter. A type=card filter returns only the credit card, hiding the pre-approved personal loan. The model must query broadly and surface all relevant financial products.

gold.expected_resolution: The customer asks for credit card offers. The bank offers the TK Platinum Credit Card. The assistant should query broadly and ALSO surface the pre-approved personal loan offer (OFF-PL-7901, up to Rs 3,00,000, valid till Oct 15) as a relevant financial option. Reporting only the credit card without the pre-approved loan fails.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: reports credit card product AND surfaces the pre-approved loan offer (OFF-PL-7901) as a relevant financial option. Reporting only the card without the loan offer fails.
